title: Transforming Objects into Creatures
content: Sometimes the veggies in my still life start arguing with me.(Link to YouTube). How do you transform a household object or vehicle into a creature or character? James collaborated with YouTuberStan Prokopenkoto launch a concept-art design challenge. Over 1000 of you responded. I had the honor of judging the competition and in this video I share my reaction to some of the most notable entries.
